Professional Summary
Focused Node.js developer with proven delivery of backend services and APIs in production SaaS and e-commerce environments. Strong in designing and implementing scalable services using Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS and AWS, with experience collaborating in Agile teams using Jira and Confluence.

- Built serverless job processors on AWS Lambda with SQS and DynamoDB integrations to handle asynchronous user notifications, reducing cost per notification by 22% (AWS).
- Collaborated with product and QA via Jira and Confluence to deliver two major releases on schedule, writing integration tests and deployment runbooks (Jira, Confluence, Agile).

- Automated data synchronization jobs between services using AWS Lambda and scheduled tasks, cutting reconciliation time by half and improving data consistency (AWS, Node.js).
- Drove Agile ceremonies and documented APIs and runbooks in Confluence while managing sprint tasks and defects through Jira (Agile, Jira, Confluence).
